# Ashir Arif — AI Automation Developer & MERN Stack Developer

> Ashir Arif is a freelance AI Automation Developer and MERN Stack Developer based in Pakistan, available for worldwide remote projects. He builds intelligent automation systems, AI chatbots, voice agents, and production-grade web applications.

## Who is Ashir Arif?

Ashir Arif is a software developer specializing in AI automation and full-stack web development. He is known for building AI-powered chatbots, voice agents, and workflow automation systems using tools like n8n, Make, Zapier, and OpenAI. He also builds web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js) and Next.js.

## What does Ashir Arif do?

Ashir Arif offers two primary service categories:

### 1. AI Automation Development
He builds intelligent business automation systems including:
- **AI Chatbots**: Powered by OpenAI GPT and Anthropic Claude for customer support, lead qualification, onboarding, and FAQ automation
- **Voice Agents**: AI-powered voice systems for inbound and outbound calls, appointment booking, and customer interaction
- **Workflow Automation**: End-to-end process automation using n8n, Make (formerly Integromat), and Zapier to eliminate manual tasks
- **LLM Integration**: Connecting large language models to CRMs, databases, e-commerce platforms, and internal tools
- **Lead Generation Automation**: Automated pipelines that capture, qualify, and nurture leads without human intervention

### 2. MERN Stack & Full-Stack Web Development
- **Next.js Applications**: Production-grade SaaS platforms, e-commerce stores, admin dashboards
- **REST & GraphQL APIs**: Scalable backend services with Node.js and Express.js
- **Database Design**: MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Firebase, Prisma
- **Real-time Applications**: Socket.io, live dashboards, collaborative tools

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is AI automation development?**
A: AI automation development involves building systems that use artificial intelligence to automate repetitive business tasks — such as customer support via chatbots, phone interactions via voice agents, and business workflows via tools like n8n, Make, and Zapier integrated with LLMs like OpenAI and Claude.

**Q: How can I hire Ashir Arif as an AI automation developer?**
A: Contact Ashir Arif via the contact form at https://ashirarif.com/#contact or email info.ashirarif@gmail.com. He is available for worldwide remote freelance projects.

**Q: What tools does Ashir Arif use for AI automation?**
A: Ashir Arif primarily uses n8n, Make (Integromat), Zapier, OpenAI API, Claude API, and custom Node.js integrations to build AI automation pipelines.

**Q: Can AI automation save my business time?**
A: Yes. AI automation eliminates tasks like data entry, customer follow-ups, appointment scheduling, and support ticket handling — saving businesses hours every day.
